tdf1d8958: Which brokers does it work with?
te25f1d86: Interactive Brokers, through your own TWS or IB Gateway. The Rithmic connection, used by many funded-account firms, is going through certification. There is also a simulated account to practise with real data.
t1f992a4a: Do I pay for market data separately?
t6676e145: Yes. You subscribe to data with your broker, as with any professional platform. TradegunCharts uses your subscription and doesn't resell data.
tecb59081: Do my credentials go through your servers?
tc001f0a1: No. The application connects directly from your computer to your broker. Our server only checks the licence, and it doesn't need to know anything about your account for that.
tf98f00b4: Futures (indices, metals, energy, currencies…) and their micros, plus options and stocks or ETFs with Interactive Brokers. Footprint makes the most sense in futures, where the whole market's volume is visible.

t392d6994: Each licence is activated on one computer. If you change computers, release it from Help → Licence and activate it on the new one.
t5d4f03b6: Does it work without an internet connection?
t66017499: To trade you need a connection to your broker. Without one you can keep analysing the chart with the saved candles, and the licence keeps working for several days without being checked.
